summary: A domesticated freshwater carp developed in China through centuries of selective breeding. Body shapes, fins and colours differ greatly between varieties; adult fish need substantial space and filtration rather than a small bowl.
nativeRange: China; ornamental strains have been introduced widely.

features: Colour and body shape vary among domesticated breeds.
More pointed snout than a crucian carp; young goldfish lack the crucian carp's dark tail-base spot.
Domestic colours include white, yellow, orange, red, brown and black.

habitat.diet: Omnivorous; prepared foods can be supplemented with plant material and small invertebrates.
